media.kind: Actual native-site recording with labeled explanatory reading pauses
media.edit: Seven labeled reading pauses added to the original verified recording. Original motion and command output remain at normal speed; no new transaction or test run is implied.

readingPauses.title: DEPLOYMENT PROOF
readingPauses.caption: A successful deployment receipt creates this contract address. Non-empty runtime bytecode confirms that Solidity code exists on the local EVM.

readingPauses.title: THE SIGNED OFFER
readingPauses.caption: The EIP-712 signature binds the buyer, file and terms fingerprints, amount, fee, shares and expiry. Changing a signed value invalidates the offer.

readingPauses.title: ESCROW HOLDS THE PAYMENT
readingPauses.caption: The 0.012 test ETH stays in the contract after deposit. The license has not started, and recipients cannot withdraw this order’s proceeds yet.

readingPauses.title: LICENSE OWNERSHIP
readingPauses.caption: Acceptance records the buyer wallet, artwork and selected license on-chain. ArtGuard verifies the release before unlocking the protected original file.

readingPauses.title: REVENUE ALLOCATION
readingPauses.caption: 0.012 test ETH minus 10% leaves 0.0108: creator credit 0.0081, co-author credit 0.0027. Each recipient withdraws separately; gas is additional.

readingPauses.title: VERIFY THE TRANSACTIONS
readingPauses.caption: Deposit, release and withdrawal have different transaction hashes. The local EVM confirms successful receipts, canonical blocks and the active license.

readingPauses.title: READ THE ACTUAL TEST RESULTS
readingPauses.caption: This recorded run passed 21 selected application unit tests and 10 EVM escrow tests: 0 failures, exit code 0. These are actual results from the saved run.

TAP version 13
ok 1 - deposit holds funds, issues no license or revenue, checks permissions and rejects invalid quotes
ok 2 - acceptance releases exact fees and co-author shares, starts the period and makes withdrawals real
ok 3 - no delivery permits a full refundable credit after 72 hours, then an exact wallet refund and repurchase
ok 4 - review timeout enables release without buyer acceptance; it never releases just from an API read
ok 5 - dispute blocks payouts, manager decisions are authorized, recorded and verified on-chain
ok 6 - manager may release a valid disputed delivery; unresolved disputes allow refund after 7 days
ok 7 - bulk deposits can settle independently and a restart preserves escrow state and released licenses
ok 8 - the new contract inherits older license expiry and preserves the older contract credits
ok 9 - reconciliation distinguishes locked deposits, recipient credits and refunded credits at the same block
ok 10 - prepared demo wallets fund, deliver, release, dispute and withdraw refunds through the restricted site signer

proof.message: The local node confirms this deposit and the current escrow state. Allocations and withdrawals are separate transactions.

checks.label: Deposit succeeded at a configured escrow contract
Deposit belongs to the canonical block and deployed contract code
Transaction calls buyLicenses to fund escrow
Transferred amount equals the signed order total
EscrowFunded events match buyer, seller, file, terms, price and period
Contract storage and consumed quote match order 0x6f73d31c
A unique on-chain settlement event exists
Settlement transaction succeeded at the escrow contract
License and period were issued on release, not deposit
All creator and co-author allocations match the signed split
